# Diana & Ruby Gillis

- [Diana](../character/diana.md) — Friend of — [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) — friends visiting and playing together · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a tearful, romantic farewell after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Consoled by their devotion and a exchanged lock of hair, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and receives a secret note of friendship from [Diana](../character/diana.md). She dedicates herself to her studies, engaging in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while maintaining her silence toward him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spend a quiet evening together studying and talking. [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) rushes in to beg for help because her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is gravely ill with croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne.md) hurries to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) using her past experience with Mrs. Hammond's children, saving the baby's life. Touched by Anne's rescue, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives her for the past incident with [Diana](../character/diana.md), allowing the two girls to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on the arrival of spring and her first year living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to retrieve an apron pattern from the Barrys' house at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana.md) imagined the spruce grove to be the "[Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood)." To break [Anne](../character/anne.md) of her frightening imaginings, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists she walk through the woods anyway, resulting in a terrifying trip for [Anne](../character/anne.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns from school emotional about Mr. Phillips's departure and shares news of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After praising Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and making extensive preparations with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) bakes a layer cake for the minister and his wife's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During tea, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sample the cake, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to react in shock at its unusual taste.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne.md) eagerly embraces despite Marilla's skepticism. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) criticizes the concert as a distraction from schoolwork, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) warmly encourages Anne's enthusiasm.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) on Anne's thirteenth birthday, discussing growing up, school assignments, and romantic story plots. [Anne](../character/anne.md) proposes starting a story club to cultivate their imaginations, which eventually expands to include other classmates like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the story club's progress, defending their work and sharing her aspirations to be like Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to finish her household chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on the pond, but the dory leaks and begins to sink, forcing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) angrily refuses his offer of apology and friendship. Later, back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on learning her lesson about romance, while [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gently advises her not to abandon it entirely.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on her silent academic rivalry and unspoken regret concerning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exam. [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly packs away her books for a fun summer at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and commends Anne's growth and character.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a restful summer outdoors per doctor's orders before resuming her studies for the upcoming [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. As the school year progresses, [Anne](../character/anne.md) matures into a quieter fifteen-year-old girl, growing taller than [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and shifting her focus to simple, disciplined writing. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a sense of loss over [Anne](../character/anne.md) growing up, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) worries about the anxiety and potential failure surrounding the crucial exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school term and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After weeks of anxious waiting, [Diana](../character/diana.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the published results to reveal that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) shares the proud news with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before ending her night with a thankful prayer.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), though leaving [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) brings emotional farewells. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students adjust to their new environment and classes. In her boarding house room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels homesick until her schoolmates visit and share news about an upcoming Avery scholarship, sparking new academic ambitions.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while continuing her intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys weekend visits home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the autumn and spends spare time visiting [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final exams loom, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends gather to discuss their anxieties, upcoming commencement clothes, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) expresses sadness about [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) clarifies that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is strictly a friend and describes her idealized view of love. The two girls discuss local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong affection for each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> During an overnight stay, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) declines the offer, and Jane accepts the refusal coolly while noting that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects with a mixture of amusement and disappointment at how unromantic her very first marriage proposal turned out to be.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

> Upon returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices small changes in the community and learns from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill with consumption. On their way to visit [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) stop by to leave jelly with the sour and critical [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) confides in [Diana](../character/diana.md) her ambition to write a short story before they arrive at the lively Gillis home, where [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) hides her failing health under a façade of gay flirtation.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends an evening in the garden with [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her desire to go on living. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves, [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on life and death while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl
